name: Therylune's Escape
summary: Therylune is cornered by cultists at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. She wandered into its dig sites, and you are needed to guide her to safety and tell her worried sister, Therysil, at the Shrine of Aessina that she survived.

sections.title: A Perilous Stroll
sections.body: At the Master's Glaive, Therylune is pinned down by Twilight's Hammer cultists. The ravine is dominated by the skull of an ancient monstrosity, pierced by a huge stone blade. Therylune wandered into the heart of the valley despite the dread surrounding it. She survives by reacting quickly and hiding among the rough terrain.

sections.title: Word to the Shrine
sections.body: Therysil waits far to the south at the Shrine of Aessina. Her adventurous sister Therylune rarely minds getting dirt on her clothes, but even Therysil was shocked to learn she had ventured into the unwholesome excavations at the Master's Glaive. Word that Therylune is safe will ease her worry. Therysil knows the dark forces digging through Darkshore's ancient earth.

faq.answer: Therylune is an adventurous young night elf who wandered into the dangerous excavations at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. She is Therysil's sister.
Therysil is Therylune's sister and lives at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale. She is dismayed that her sibling wandered so close to a dark, tainted place.

faq.q: Why is the Master's Glaive so dangerous?
faq.answer: The Master's Glaive is a foreboding ravine where an ancient old lord fell long ago. Twilight's Hammer cultists swarm the site, digging there and attacking trespassers.

faq.q: Where does Therylune need to be escorted?
faq.answer: Therylune needs an escort away from the Master's Glaive to safety. Afterward, you need to travel to the Shrine of Aessina and tell her sister she survived.

faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Aessina located?
faq.answer: The Shrine of Aessina lies in southwestern Ashenvale, west of Astranaar. It is a sanctuary dedicated to the forest spirit Aessina.

faq.q: How did Therylune survive surrounded by cultists?
faq.answer: Therylune avoided capture by hiding among the rocks and terrain before the surrounding Twilight's Hammer cultists could spot her.

angles.text: The Master's Glaive marks an ancient scar in Kalimdor's history. Seeing a fellow kaldorei wander into cultist excavations is a sobering reminder of the threats within Ashenvale.
When you help wayfarers like Therylune, you strengthen the Alliance's presence and goodwill among the night elves defending Ashenvale.
